title: Episode 1
overview: Agetarou would rather go clubbing than work at his family's tonkatsu restaurant. But his tonkatsu-making skills might be the key to making him the greatest DJ of all time!

title: Episode 2
overview: Agetarou learns the sacred art of diggin' for records at his local shop, gathers up some equipment and hosts his first party.

title: Episode 3
overview: Agetarou makes a weird deal with DJ Oily to learn the secrets of the Quick Mix.

title: Episode 4
overview: It's time for Agetarou's first DJ session! But can he master Scratchin' and Poppin', the final secrets of the DJ's art?!

title: Episode 5
overview: Agetarou's first real audience is hungry for both tonkatsu and beats. Can he sail through smoothly, or will he fall prey to the DJ demons?
